reviews.author: Jessica
reviews.text: So glad I found Jenny! Her knowledge and attention to detail is impeccable. She has colors and products to accommodate every client and puts her time and effort into making sure you're happy with your results.

reviews.author: Erika
reviews.text: Best service! Jenny is always professional, enthusiastic, clean and very artistic! Love her work and her ability to create beautiful nails.

reviews.author: Doris
reviews.text: Jenny is super nice, everything is sanitary, so many colors to choose from. Never disappointed with her designs. I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Lakeisha
reviews.text: She is amazing and talented. Her space is beautiful. Book her asap!

reviews.author: Sandra
reviews.text: Me encanta el trabajo que hace, es muy profecional.

reviews_source: Quotes verbatim extraidas de la pagina publica de Booksy (id 488671), en su idioma original (una en espanol, respetada tal cual la escribio la clienta incluyendo su tilde ortografica original).
brand_vibe: Nail artist boutique home-based, especializada en Apres Gel-X, acrylic/polygel y nail art freestyle elaborado (encapsulados con flores 3D, charms, Swarovski, chrome). El feed y la galeria de Booksy muestran una estetica glam editorial: tonos nude/blush glossy y burgundy/vino con brillo dorado como base recurrente (sets nude-burgundy con acento dorado, manicures perla, blush rosado), salpicada de disenos statement en colores joya (azul cobalto, verde esmeralda/chrome, coral). Fondos de foto en satin blanco y crema, luz suave editorial. Encaja con una paleta clara calida (blush/crema) con acento profundo vino/burgundy y dorado rosado, transmitiendo lujo accesible y artesania de precision.

images.source: Galeria publica de Booksy (id 488671): biz_photo, inspiration x6, resource_photos, service_photos x3, review_photos x17. Descargadas via curl directo del CDN de Booksy (d2zdpiztbgorvt.cloudfront.net), verificadas con 'file' (todas JPEG reales), curadas visualmente una por una, redimensionadas a max 1000px de ancho con Pillow calidad 82.

Se descartaron ademas fotos oscuras/mal iluminadas y duplicados de estilo similar para mantener variedad.
